article.headline: Hobbs scores 13 as Mount St. Mary's takes down Rider 79-72
article.description: — Dallas Hobbs and Terrell Ard Jr. score 13 points apiece to help Mount St. Mary's defeat Rider 79-72 on Sunday.
article.linkText: Hobbs scores 13 as Mount St. Mary's takes down Rider 79-72
article.story: EMMITSBURG, Md. -- — Dallas Hobbs and Terrell Ard Jr. score 13 points apiece to help Mount St. Mary's defeat Rider 79-72 on Sunday. Hobbs added six rebounds for the Mountaineers (17-10, 10-6 Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference). Ard made 4 of 10 from the field and 5 for 7 from the free-throw line and added five rebounds. Dola Adebayo shot 4 of 9 from the field, including 1 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 2 for 3 from the foul line to finish with 11 points. TJ Weeks Jr. finished with 18 points and three steals for the Broncs (10-18, 6-11). Tariq Ingraham added 15 points and 11 rebounds for Rider. Zion Cruz also put up 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
